h: Classic stages and Career tracks: what's the difference? 🧩
x: Both are solo code modes in the Work tab. Classic stages (called Classic challenges on screen) is the mode where you find and fix errors yourself; Career tracks is the mode where you judge O/X whether each line has an error. Classic stages Career tracks What you do Find and tap the wrong symbol in a file Look at a line: O for an error / X for clean Stages 500, opening one at a time from 1 5 tracks, 1,200 per track (12 chapters of 100 each). Chapters are all open; stages inside a chapter open one at a time Language JavaScript Differs by track (Frontend JS, TS; Backend Java, TS; Python/AI; Data SQL, Python; Full stack all 5) Star criteria 1 to 300: wrong answers / 301+: time In each chapter, 1 to 80: accuracy / 81 to 100: time Coffee reward 1 coffee per new star (up to 3 per stage), up to 10 times a day on the same stage

h: Classic stages (called Classic challenges on screen) strategy
x: The Classic stage screen. The time is at the top center, the minimap on the right, and the ☕ button at the top right is Drink coffee . How to fix Check // Today's ticket Before you start, it shows which kinds of errors to find in this stage. Tap Start working and the clock starts. Tap a suspicious line When the line zooms in, tap the wrong symbol . For errors with a missing semicolon or colon, tap End (end of line). Stuck? Coffee Tap the ☕ button at the top right ( Drink coffee ) and the line with the error turns yellow . It costs 1 coffee. Watch out for wrong taps A wrong tap adds 10 seconds . Take too long and the lead nags you, adding even more time. Swipe sideways through long code, and tap or drag the minimap to jump straight to that line. You can change the text size with + − too. The 13 error types and the order they appear Stages 1 to 300 teach the errors one group at a time, and from 301 all 13 come mixed together. Stages Errors that appear Example 1~20 Missing semicolon (;) return total 21~40 Mismatched brackets, ) where a closing brace } should be fetch(url] 41~80 Review of the 3 above 81~100 The letter O instead of the number 0 limit = 1O0; 101~120 A colon where a semicolon goes, a semicolon where a colon goes total = 0: 121~160 Review of everything so far 161~180 A comma (,) where a period (.) goes, a period where a comma goes user,name 181~200 Review 201~210 Mismatched quotes name = 'admin"; 211~220 Values with the wrong case isActive = True; 221~230 Keyword typ

In Career tracks you pick O (has an error) / X (clean) for each line. 5 tracks: Frontend, Backend, Python/AI, Data, Full stack . You can switch any time, and records are kept per track. In each chapter, 1 to 80 teach errors by type, and 81 to 100 are the hell zone where every error appears. Stars: for 1 to 80, 60% accuracy is ★★, 80% is ★★★ . For 81 to 100, time. Get one wrong and an error explanation appears, and the clock stops while you read it. Great for studying too 📚 Size: stage 1 of a chapter starts with 2 checks (60 lines), stage 80 has 200, and stage 100 grows to 2,000 checks (100,000 lines). Tip Guessing (around 50% accuracy) never gets you past ★. To get ★★★ on 1 to 80 you need 4 right out of 5.

Leave a Classic stage or Career track partway and it stays in Saved stages at the top of the Work tab with the same file, time and progress. There is 1 slot per mode, so saving another stage overwrites it. A resumed run still earns stars and coffee, but does not count for No-coffee records .

h: Replying to messages, leaving them on read
x: When you wrap up a week, messages pile up in the Messenger. Each reply changes stats and affinity, and a reply comes right back when you answer. Messages you did not answer last week are treated as left on read at the next close, and clearing notifications also counts as leaving them all on read. People with affinity (heroines, lead, senior, junior) lose affinity when left on read, so be careful. Tap a profile to pin it to the top.

Each project shows its recommended power. 16 fields with 12 each, so 192 in all. 3 fields are open at first, and every 3 projects you clear opens 1 more field. Within a field they go in order. Win at or above the recommendation and it is always 3 stars . If a line your crew put in the report box is real, tap Fix ; if not, False Alarm . A price moves as the sum of three things: base value , overheating and event hype . Base value : goes up and down a little every week (noise), and is pulled slightly by each company's hidden trend this quarter . When the market mood is good, it rises along with it by its beta. Overheating : the part where people overreacted to the news. 40% of it disappears every week . That is why a price that jumped a lot partly comes back. Event hype : as a scheduled event approaches, the price rises in advance; the moment the result comes out, the hype vanishes and the result is priced in.

h: Earnings: they move on the gap from expectations
x: Earnings come out at the week close every 13 weeks of your career (weeks 13, 26, 39, 52, 65, 78, 91) . A stock's details show Earnings in week N, market expectations very low to very high . The hidden trend Each company has a hidden trend this quarter. Reports tell you its direction 78% of the time. Market expectations Expectations move a little each time a report or tabloid comes out (less for tabloids). This is the value you see on screen. The release The price moves by the gap between the real trend and market expectations , and more volatile stocks move more. A little overheating is added on top (it soon fades). If the real result is clearly better than expected it is an earnings surprise! , clearly worse an earnings shock… , and close to it in line with expectations . The next quarter If this quarter was good, the market expects a lot from the next one too, but the real trend does not carry over that much. So after a blowout quarter, expectations run too high and a shock comes easily. Tip Late in a quarter (weeks 8 to 12), if reports have come out several times in the same direction but market expectations are still Normal , that is your chance. On the other hand, a stock that jumped right after earnings is already priced with overheating, so you are too late.
